ABOUT KYTE

Curious people.
Considered work.

We're a design and creative agency based in India.
We help you shape the product, build the brand
and carry the story into the world.

OUR APPROACH

We like making
things make sense.

Clear thinking sits behind the work. We ask questions, make ideas tangible and pay attention to how the details fit together.

Our practice spans product and UI/UX design, branding, content and video. That gives us room to consider the experience as a whole, from what people use to what they see and hear about it.

HOW WE SHOW UP

A few things we work by.

Think clearly

Understand the problem before rushing to an answer.

Stay curious

Ask questions and leave room for a better direction.

Make better

Use feedback to refine the work, not just add another version.

Ship well

Carry the detail through to the final experience.

THE PEOPLE

Small conversations. Shared ambition.

Kyte is led by Vedant Malkarnekar and Varun Padmanabhan, working with a team across design, content and production.
